items.title: Speculative Encoding: Many-to-Many Cache Translation (24 minute read)
items.snippet: Agents are increasingly passing context to one another as text. Speculative encoding translates hidden states directly from one model to another. It makes the model start answering faster than prefilling the text while keeping most of its accuracy. Prefill costs grow quadratically with context length, and prefill repeats much of what the sending model has already computed.
